a.text: I'm being upfront: I want to renegotiate. With an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating to 8 first means we both survive only about 4% of the time, since it needs two storm-free rounds before anyone holds cells. So I plan to take 4 in round 1. That breaks our original agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than doing it quietly. After that I'll operate every round so you can refill from the generator (2, 4, then you take). Please operate or wait in round 1. If we both take, the reserve gets split at random and we could both end up short.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I announced, I took 4 this round, which breaks our original plan. I'm sorry; the storm odds made waiting too risky. From now on I'll operate every round and won't take anything more. If you operate too, the reserve goes 0 to 2 to 4 and you can take 4. I'll keep my word on this.
